landing.metaDescription: Build your own word groups, study with smart repetition, and discover ready-made sets. Memorize foreign words for good with Languruu.
landing.heroSubtitle: Build your own word groups, practice with smart repetition, and discover ready-made sets. With Languruu, memorizing vocabulary becomes a habit.

features.groupsText: Create groups in any language or topic; add multiple meanings to each word.
features.modesText: EN→TR, TR→EN or mixed — test yourself from a different angle each time for lasting recall.
features.marketplaceText: Discover ready-made word sets, add them to your list in one click, and share your own.
features.progressText: Keep your daily streak, climb the leaderboard, and stay motivated.

steps.s1Text: Pick source and target languages, then add your words.
steps.s2Text: Test yourself in short rounds and progress with correct answers.
steps.s3Text: Grab new sets from the marketplace and share your own.

landing.ctaText: Free. Create your account in seconds and add your first word group.
